page.layout: One printed page (left-hand page of the opening, text block centred, with a narrow column of text at the right edge of the scan belonging to the facing page, cut off). Main text: one column, running from the head line to the last full line. Right edge: cropped fragments of the facing page's text, treated as notes-free show-through of the neighbouring page and not transcribed.

main_text.p: Hunc sequitur equestris praefectus excubia-rum, qui praeest excubiis equitum, & tesseram militarem accipit & distribuit, der Reisigen Wachtmeister.
Post hunc est equestris praetor, sive praefectus rerum capitalium, der Reuterschafft Profoß.
Sine magistratu in regimine equitum sunt Pastor, Medicus, Chirurgus, der reisigen Balbierer.
Inferiores officiarii in regimine sunt Scribae, praefecti equitum; 2, tubicines equitum, qui multi & varii esse solent in hoc regimine. 3, Tympanistae, die Heerpaucker.

p.i: Sequuntur officiarii in regimine rei armamentariae, in der ArckLey Regiment; qui etiam sunt vel superiores vel inferiores.
Superiores sunt vel excellentiores, vel minus excellentes.

main_text.p: Excellentes sunt duo: 1, magister supremus rei armamentariae, der oberster Ackleymeister; 2 eius Vicarius.

Minus excellentes sunt, 1, Quaestor armamentarius, der Artaley zahlmeister. 2, Aggeribus struendis praefectus, der Schanzmeister; 3, rei armamentariae quaesitor, der Artaley Profoß; 4, rei armamentariae custos; qui nempe omnem rem armamentariam habet sub sua potestate & custodia, der Zeugwarter; 5, aurigarum

page.notes: Right margin and right edge of the scan carry fragments of the facing page (garum, quadr-, Wag-, Inf-, Ho-, etc.); not transcribed. Greek or Hebrew: none. Some German words are in black letter within italic Latin (rendered in roman here). Uncertain readings: "Ackleymeister" (line end, possibly "Ackleymeister"); the final line "aurigarum" is a catchword-like fragment continuing onto the next page and is printed at the line end, not as a catchword.
